Image without alt text produces image markdown

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<img src=\"banner.jpg\">", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
